title: Why “hospitalisation” is trending in FR: 200+ searches, the facts (November 26, 2026)
description: “hospitalisation” is trending in FR with 200+ searches reported by Google. The verified coverage behind the spike, from Libération and 2 more.

sections.heading: What is trending: “hospitalisation”
paragraphs: “hospitalisation” appeared on Google Trends' Trending Now list for FR (snapshot taken 2026-11-26T15:13:56+00:00 UTC). Google reports at least 200 searches for this term — that figure is a lower bound published in the official Trends feed, not an exact count.

sections.heading: What's behind the spike — the coverage
paragraphs: The Trends feed associates this search spike with 3 news stories from Libération, RTL, Radio France. The headlines, exactly as published:
list: “Conseils médicaux de l’IA : l’Agence du médicament rapporte huit cas d’effets indésirables, dont une hospitalisation” — Libération
“Vous demandez à ChatGPT quels médicaments prendre ? Pourquoi les autorités sanitaires appellent à la prudence” — RTL
“"Il faut le faire en transparence avec son soignant" : un médecin alerte sur les dangers de l'IA pour des conseils santé” — Radio France

sections.heading: Timeline
paragraphs: The trend entry was published to the Google Trends feed at Thu, 26 Nov 2026 07:00:00 -0800. Our snapshot was taken at 2026-11-26T15:13:56+00:00 UTC and this briefing was assembled at 2026-11-26T15:15:01+00:00 UTC.

sections.heading: How to read these numbers
paragraphs: Google Trends reports approximate search volume as a lower bound (for example “20K+”). Actual volume can be significantly higher. Trending status reflects acceleration in searches, not the absolute size of a topic. For the full story behind the spike, read the cited coverage below — this briefing intentionally adds no speculation beyond the sourced facts.

This snapshot covers FR. The same term may trend differently in other regions.
